moworks.notes: Idea and numbers (TakayuStudio tx-iris-reveal, written here): Text (on a card panel) revealed by a growing circle clip: centre at the click point (demo 30 % across the text, mid-height; CSS --x 30 % --y 50 %), radius 0 → 150 % (to the farthest frame corner) over 0.8 s cubic-bezier(.7,0,.3,1); a 1.5 px accent rim follows the circle until it nearly fills. Demo: cursor clicks at 0.5 s, open 0.7–1.5 s, close 2.9–3.7 s (same ease); loop 4.2 s. Params: x, y: tâm vòng (30 %, 50 %) · duration (0.8 s) · ease (cubic-bezier(.7,0,.3,1)) · rim: viền vòng (1.5 px).
moworks.titleVi: Chữ hiện qua vòng tròn mở rộng
